role_summary: Own Q2 and Q4 by making evidence absence, qualifications, and applicability scope executable for crop-and-system score eligibility.
recommendation: Use explicit evidence-assessment rows for every crop × axis × intended-use target; never encode search coverage with NULL or a missing fact. Store candidate numeric facts separately, attach orthogonal qualifications and normalized scope sets, then evaluate role, disqualifiers, and exact context matches with a fail-closed SQL predicate.
why: NULL cannot distinguish failed extraction from a documented search result; explicit assessment states can.
The registry assigns multiple independent qualifications to one item, so a bridge table preserves combinations without precedence bugs.
Explicit all/exact/not_applicable/unreported scope modes prevent an omitted cultivar or system from silently becoming universal.
Policy and scope-requirement tables turn each registry instruction into testable, versionable data.
schema_sketch:
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE crop (
  crop_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name_ko TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE sensor_axis (
  axis_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  axis_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  sensor_channel TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE use_case (
  use_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY
);
INSERT INTO use_case VALUES
 ('growth_score'), ('recommendation'), ('automated_control'),
 ('alarm'), ('lethality'), ('time_based_alarm'), ('auto_clear'),
 ('disease_risk');

CREATE TABLE document_revision (
  revision_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  captured_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE scope_dimension (
  dimension_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  required_for_scoring INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(required_for_scoring IN (0,1))
);
INSERT INTO scope_dimension VALUES
 ('cultivar',1), ('cultivation_system',1), ('medium',1),
 ('growth_stage',1), ('measurement_profile',1), ('facility',1);

-- Exact identity prevents field-capacity %, pot-relative %, VWC, lux, PPFD,
-- irrigation-water EC, and nutrient-solution EC from being compared accidentally.
CREATE TABLE measurement_profile (
  profile_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  quantity_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  unit_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  basis_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  method_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  medium_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  sensor_model_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(quantity_code, unit_code, basis_code, method_code, medium_code, sensor_model_code)
);

CREATE TABLE scope_value (
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scope_dimension,
  value_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  measurement_profile_code TEXT REFERENCES measurement_profile,
  PRIMARY KEY(dimension_code, value_code),
  CHECK(
    (dimension_code='measurement_profile'
      AND measurement_profile_code IS NOT NULL
      AND measurement_profile_code=value_code)
    OR
    (dimension_code<>'measurement_profile'
      AND measurement_profile_code IS NULL)
  )
);

CREATE TABLE scope_set (
  scope_set_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
);

-- all: curator explicitly asserts no restriction; exact: listed values only;
-- not_applicable: dimension is irrelevant; unreported: unknown and therefore fails closed.
CREATE TABLE scope_set_dimension (
  scope_set_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scope_set ON DELETE CASCADE,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scope_dimension,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('all','exact','not_applicable','unreported')),
  PRIMARY KEY(scope_set_id, dimension_code)
);

CREATE TABLE scope_set_value (
  scope_set_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(scope_set_id, dimension_code, value_code),
  FOREIGN KEY(scope_set_id, dimension_code)
    REFERENCES scope_set_dimension(scope_set_id, dimension_code) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(dimension_code, value_code)
    REFERENCES scope_value(dimension_code, value_code)
);

CREATE TRIGGER scope_value_requires_exact
BEFORE INSERT ON scope_set_value
WHEN (SELECT mode FROM scope_set_dimension
      WHERE scope_set_id=NEW.scope_set_id
        AND dimension_code=NEW.dimension_code) <> 'exact'
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'scope values require exact mode');
END;

CREATE TABLE cultivation_context (
  context_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  context_code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

-- System Y carries every known applicable tag, including its sensor profiles.
CREATE TABLE context_scope_value (
  context_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES cultivation_context ON DELETE CASCADE,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  value_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(context_id, dimension_code, value_code),
  FOREIGN KEY(dimension_code, value_code)
    REFERENCES scope_value(dimension_code, value_code)
);

-- Absence is an assertion, not a missing row. Materialize this grid for all eight crops.
CREATE TABLE evidence_assessment (
  assessment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  crop_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES crop,
  axis_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sensor_axis,
  use_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES use_case,
  target_scope_set_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scope_set,
  coverage_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(coverage_state IN (
    'not_reviewed',
    'reviewed_no_direct_evidence',
    'reviewed_values_found',
    'not_applicable'
  )),
  revision_id INTEGER REFERENCES document_revision,
  source_locator TEXT,
  reviewed_at TEXT,
  note TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK(
    (coverage_state='not_reviewed' AND revision_id IS NULL AND reviewed_at IS NULL)
    OR
    (coverage_state<>'not_reviewed' AND revision_id IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)
  )
);

CREATE TABLE evidence_role (
  role_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY
);
INSERT INTO evidence_role VALUES
 ('growth_optimum'), ('validated_growth_target'), ('disease_risk'),
 ('injury_threshold'), ('experimental_condition'), ('operating_condition'),
 ('base_temperature'), ('observed_response');

-- Missing rows deny use. This preserves optimum/disease/injury distinctions without a formula.
CREATE TABLE role_use_allow (
  role_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_role,
  use_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES use_case,
  PRIMARY KEY(role_code, use_code)
);
INSERT INTO role_use_allow VALUES
 ('growth_optimum','growth_score'),
 ('validated_growth_target','growth_score'),
 ('disease_risk','disease_risk'),
 ('disease_risk','alarm'),
 ('injury_threshold','alarm');

CREATE TABLE coverage_use_allow (
  coverage_state TEXT NOT NULL,
  use_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES use_case,
  PRIMARY KEY(coverage_state, use_code)
);
INSERT INTO coverage_use_allow VALUES
 ('reviewed_values_found','growth_score');

CREATE TABLE evidence_fact (
  fact_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  assessment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_assessment,
  scope_set_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scope_set,
  role_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_role,
  crop_relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(crop_relation IN ('direct_crop','general_reference')),
  is_numeric INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_numeric IN (0,1)),
  value_min REAL,
  value_max REAL,
  unit_code TEXT,
  source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK(
    (is_numeric=0 AND value_min IS NULL AND value_max IS NULL)
    OR
    (is_numeric=1 AND (value_min IS NOT NULL OR value_max IS NOT NULL))
  )
);

-- no_direct_evidence intentionally lives in evidence_assessment.coverage_state.
CREATE TABLE qualification (
  qualification_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY
);
INSERT INTO qualification VALUES
 ('cultivar_specific'), ('system_specific'), ('stage_specific'),
 ('general_crop_reference'), ('experimental_condition_only'),
 ('measurement_not_transferable'), ('not_a_risk_threshold'),
 ('insufficient_duration_data'), ('no_recovery_threshold');

CREATE TABLE fact_qualification (
  fact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_fact ON DELETE CASCADE,
  qualification_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qualification,
  PRIMARY KEY(fact_id, qualification_code)
);

CREATE TABLE qualification_block (
  qualification_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qualification,
  use_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES use_case,
  PRIMARY KEY(qualification_code, use_code)
);
INSERT INTO qualification_block VALUES
 ('experimental_condition_only','growth_score'),
 ('experimental_condition_only','recommendation'),
 ('experimental_condition_only','automated_control'),
 ('general_crop_reference','growth_score'),
 ('general_crop_reference','automated_control'),
 ('not_a_risk_threshold','alarm'),
 ('not_a_risk_threshold','lethality'),
 ('insufficient_duration_data','time_based_alarm'),
 ('no_recovery_threshold','auto_clear');

-- Dimensions in one requirement_group are alternatives; separate groups would all be required.
CREATE TABLE qualification_scope_requirement (
  qualification_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qualification,
  requirement_group INTEGER NOT NULL,
  dimension_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scope_dimension,
  PRIMARY KEY(qualification_code, requirement_group, dimension_code)
);
INSERT INTO qualification_scope_requirement VALUES
 ('cultivar_specific',1,'cultivar'),
 ('stage_specific',1,'growth_stage'),
 ('system_specific',1,'cultivation_system'),
 ('system_specific',1,'medium'),
 ('system_specific',1,'facility'),
 ('system_specific',1,'measurement_profile'),
 ('measurement_not_transferable',1,'measurement_profile');

-- Query: which axes may be scored for crop X in system/context Y?
WITH eligible_fact AS (
  SELECT f.fact_id, ea.axis_id
  FROM evidence_fact f
  JOIN evidence_assessment ea ON ea.assessment_id=f.assessment_id
  JOIN crop c ON c.crop_id=ea.crop_id
  JOIN cultivation_context ctx ON ctx.context_code=:system_y
  JOIN coverage_use_allow cua
    ON cua.coverage_state=ea.coverage_state AND cua.use_code=ea.use_code
  JOIN role_use_allow rua
    ON rua.role_code=f.role_code AND rua.use_code=ea.use_code
  WHERE c.crop_code=:crop_x
    AND ea.use_code='growth_score'
    AND f.is_numeric=1
    AND f.crop_relation='direct_crop'

    -- Any use-specific disqualifier rejects the fact.
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fact_qualification fq
      JOIN qualification_block qb
        ON qb.qualification_code=fq.qualification_code
       AND qb.use_code=ea.use_code
      WHERE fq.fact_id=f.fact_id
    )

    -- Every scoring dimension must be explicitly described; missing/unreported fails closed.
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM scope_dimension d
      WHERE d.required_for_scoring=1
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM scope_set_dimension sd
          WHERE sd.scope_set_id=f.scope_set_id
            AND sd.dimension_code=d.dimension_code
        )
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM scope_set_dimension sd
      WHERE sd.scope_set_id=f.scope_set_id
        AND (
          sd.mode='unreported'
          OR (sd.mode='exact' AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM scope_set_value sv
            JOIN context_scope_value cv
              ON cv.context_id=ctx.context_id
             AND cv.dimension_code=sv.dimension_code
             AND cv.value_code=sv.value_code
            WHERE sv.scope_set_id=sd.scope_set_id
              AND sv.dimension_code=sd.dimension_code
          ))
        )
    )

    -- Qualification tags must have the exact matching scope promised by their policy.
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT fq2.qualification_code, qr.requirement_group
        FROM fact_qualification fq2
        JOIN qualification_scope_requirement qr
          ON qr.qualification_code=fq2.qualification_code
        WHERE fq2.fact_id=f.fact_id
      ) required_group
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM qualification_scope_requirement qr2
        JOIN scope_set_dimension sd
          ON sd.scope_set_id=f.scope_set_id
         AND sd.dimension_code=qr2.dimension_code
         AND sd.mode='exact'
        JOIN scope_set_value sv
          ON sv.scope_set_id=sd.scope_set_id
         AND sv.dimension_code=sd.dimension_code
        JOIN context_scope_value cv
          ON cv.context_id=ctx.context_id
         AND cv.dimension_code=sv.dimension_code
         AND cv.value_code=sv.value_code
        WHERE qr2.qualification_code=required_group.qualification_code
          AND qr2.requirement_group=required_group.requirement_group
      )
    )
)
SELECT a.axis_code,
       a.sensor_channel,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ef.fact_id) AS supporting_fact_count
FROM eligible_fact ef
JOIN sensor_axis a ON a.axis_id=ef.axis_id
GROUP BY a.axis_id, a.axis_code, a.sensor_channel
ORDER BY a.axis_code;

-- Expected behavior from the documents:
-- basil optimum RH: reviewed_no_direct_evidence => no fact eligible;
-- basil field-capacity 70%: value exists but its exact profile does not match a pot sensor => excluded;
-- basil 25-30 C growth optimum: direct, role-appropriate, matching scope => air temperature eligible;
-- basil RH 85%: disease_risk role => absent from growth-score results.
scorable_axes: Air temperature — eligible where a direct growth-optimum or validated-growth-target fact survives context matching.
Soil temperature — eligible only for an exact stage/system context such as germination, never as a whole-cycle default.
unscorable_axes: Air humidity — corpus values are predominantly disease-risk conditions rather than growth-score targets.
Illuminance/light — the hardware’s lux profile does not match PPFD or DLI evidence.
CO2 concentration — the basil interaction experiment establishes no per-crop optimum or threshold.
Particulate matter/air quality — no crop-specific horticultural evidence exists in the corpus.
Noise level — it is neither evidenced nor established here as a crop-growth axis.
Soil moisture — the unspecified generic sensor cannot match field-capacity, VWC, or study-specific sensor profiles.
assumptions: System Y can supply cultivar, system, stage, medium, facility, and measurement-profile metadata; missing values fail closed.
Curators can classify semantic role, crop directness, and scope without inferring unstated applicability.
Growth scoring means role-appropriate growth targets, while disease-risk and alarm uses remain separate.
risks: An explicit six-dimension scope set per fact creates curation overhead and repetitive rows.
Exact measurement-profile equality may reject transferable evidence when publications omit harmless implementation details.
Incorrect human role or scope classifications can still create false confidence despite relational guardrails.
cheap_validation: Build one in-memory SQLite fixture containing twelve basil/lettuce facts—temperature optimum, RH disease risk, PPFD, field-capacity moisture, and explicit gaps—and assert that the query returns only air temperature for a generic pot context while admitting stage-specific soil temperature only after the stage matches.
change_mind_if: I would abandon normalized automatic eligibility for explicit human-reviewed fact-use decisions if a basil-and-lettuce pilot leaves more than 20% of numeric facts with unreported scope because the documents do not provide enough metadata.
